design.prompt_style: Fact-style unfinished two-hop question; the intermediate is implied by the clue and is absent from the prompt text.

relation_balance.status: pending taxonomy and discovery relation comparison for revised questions

controls.policy: all other eligible canonical concept names after own-name and alias-collision audit

primary_readout.endpoint: item-weighted mean fixed-layer J-Lens-minus-raw excess hit@10
primary_readout.readout_position: last prompt token immediately before target

design.surface_form_rule: The evaluator derives scored surface forms with ouro_jlens.evaldata.surface_forms and single_token_ids; semantic aliases below are annotation metadata only and are not added to the scored name axis.

dependency_design.group_rule: Pending independent connected-component audit of shared concept identities, concrete entity-substitution templates, shared source facts and final-answer collisions; no independence claim from item IDs.
dependency_design.prompt_family_rule: prompt_family_id is retained as an item construction identifier; dependency grouping is based on the audited clue and source claims, not on unique IDs.
dependency_design.collision_rule: Before freeze, merge dependency groups for any non-self semantic alias or final-answer collision, or replace the candidate before any method outcome is exposed; record the decision.

novelty_policy.old_concepts_and_aliases: Candidate canonical labels and true identity aliases are audited against historical intermediate identities; descriptive words in prompts are not treated as entity aliases.
novelty_policy.known_calibration_overlap: Retain and disclose incidental concept mentions and identified component-fact overlaps. Exclude full repeated/paraphrased discovery questions and discovery intermediate identities; audit exact/near full question overlap with calibration. No claim of calibration-unseen component facts or pretraining absence.
novelty_policy.answer_filtering: Do not filter items by model answer correctness or by either method's recovery outcome.
